floorplan_why: r5b 2026-10-12: chain turned N->S (was W->E). The 2,079-b chain (f_w 1039 + f_r 15 + f_d 1025) crossed a 432x216 tile horizontally, but the 4 SRAMs (OBS M1-M4) leave only 70.7 um of horizontal channel: M2+M4 ~2,500 derated tracks vs ~3,100 nets (2,079 through + macro-edge I/O) = 1.24 -> GRT overflow 26k, markers capped 20k (cap-0 over macros 16k; hotspot = mid channel y 90-126 + macro edges). Running the bus N->S puts it on M5, free over the macros: ~9,800 derated vertical tracks (M5 full width + M3 in channels) vs ~3,100 = 0.32; face 2,079 pins at 3 M5 tracks = 300 of 471 um. Outline 475.2 (11 x 43.2) x 216 for a 63 um mid channel (512 macro-edge pins/row). r5g: east column MY-mirrored (like pin sets face like channels).

pin_regs.reason: ot_dsrom_mtp_hrow_cbcore already registers every data port at a dedicated kept boundary flop: inputs f_w/f_r/f_d/f_bid -> wi/ri/di/id (+ the kept SRAM launch copies macro_wa/ra/wd capturing the same edge), outputs t_w/t_r/t_d = out flops wo/ro/dq. io_flop_at_pins anchors all of them at the pin faces. A generic wrapper would add 2 edges per chain tile = +20 edges per part chain (10 tiles) on every read/write/response for no structural gain. 0 cycles added.
